candidate.rationale: The DeepViewClone trait already requires ensures res.deep_view() == self.deep_view(); adding the same ensures on this impl is redundant and led to verus harness errors (res not in scope). Leave the impl without a duplicate postcondition so the trait-level spec governs the observable behavior.
risks: No per-impl postcondition will be added, but the trait-level guarantee already covers the property.
The checker also reported an unrelated private-module error; this spec change does not address that.
